# Shakya Mirror

> {{ site.description }}

Author: Harendra Shakya. Personal site covering spiritual essays, poetry, bhajans (devotional songs), Sanskrit mantras, and philosophical writing in the Indian contemplative tradition.

## Sections

- [Essays & Posts]({{ site.url }}/archive/): Main long-form writings
- [Insights]({{ site.url }}/insights/): Short aphorisms and reflections
- [Poetry]({{ site.url }}/poetry/): Original poems
- [Bhajans]({{ site.url }}/bhajan/): Devotional songs
- [Evergreen]({{ site.url }}/evergreen/): Timeless long-form essays
- [Avalokan]({{ site.url }}/avalokan/): Observations and contemplations
- [Sahitya]({{ site.url }}/sahitya/): Literary writing
- [Mantra]({{ site.url }}/mantra/): Sanskrit mantras and their meanings
- [About]({{ site.url }}/about/)
